confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Spanish Mediterranean resort pricing for July high season; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies a lot by season and availability. Cocktail and wine are based on the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation came from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, which I did not read directly. A second search did not corroborate the 15 October 2026 figure, so it should be verified against rba.gov.au before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on comparable Spanish Mediterranean coastal resort towns with similar July tourist demand, such as Salou and Torremolinos, adjusted for Benidorm's high-season hotel pricing and its large share of mid-priced restaurants.
